objective: Add the minimal provider-neutral persistence lookup required to resolve an authenticated provider event's provider reference back to the canonical InsuranceContactAttempt.

contract.identityRule: Provider identity is lookup evidence only and never replaces canonical attempt or relationship identity.

database.reason: Migration 0003 already defines a unique partial index on provider plus provider_reference.

rules: Provider and providerReference are required non-empty strings.
Lookup binds provider and provider_reference separately.
Lookup returns undefined when no attempt matches.
Canonical row parsing remains delegated to rowToAttempt.
No raw provider payload is stored.
No provider event is persisted by this lookup.
next: INS-002E2B2 will normalize Telnyx voice webhook envelopes and use this lookup plus existing provider-event receipt deduplication.
